decisions.reason: Disabling selection of the unimplemented Card option does not change the deferred wallet-provisioning behavior required for a future fiat mint.
The Transak flow is already deferred, and the source reports that Card is not yet implemented rather than changing the required future provider, accepted methods, or conversion-and-mint behavior.
Card-option selectability does not affect the independent optional tipping behavior or its configured amounts.
The source confirms USDC remains selectable and does not change the required USDC mint flow.
Disabling an unimplemented Card option does not change the $15 primary-mint allocation among the founder, affiliate, and prize pool.
The source does not change when successful-mint feedback should appear and reports no success-modal outcome.
The inability to select ETH is an execution/UI availability observation, not a change removing ETH as a required payment asset.
Payment-option availability does not change the rule that only successful mint transactions are recorded and counted.
The source does not resolve or otherwise change the outstanding policy for ETH paid above the $15 allocation.
Card-option selectability does not affect commission allocation when a mint has no referral code.
The payment-selection change has no effect on Chainlink VRF winner selection or its fairness and verification properties.

The FAQ currently describes Transak card minting as available, but the source only requires the unimplemented Card option to be unselectable; whether the FAQ should remove, defer, or qualify its fiat-minting copy requires an additional content decision.
